verdict.rationale: Paxos docs mention only a documentation-embedded AI assistant for contextual API help (paxos-docs-18), not a built-in assistant capable of executing platform tasks like payments, conversions, or identity onboarding on the user's behalf. Missing for 10: evidence of an in-product AI agent that can perform actions (transfers, KYC, order execution) rather than just answer doc questions, and any first-party or independent confirmation of agentic task delegation.
